correctness.rationale: For 0<alpha<1, DLMF 18.15.10 supplies a uniform interior asymptotic C_k^(alpha)(cos theta) with amplitude (2alpha)_k/(alpha+1)_k∼k^(alpha-1), decreasing to zero and oscillatory phase; the remainder O(k^(alpha-2)) is summable. Uniform Dirichlet summation proves S_n^(alpha)(x)=(2-2x)^(-alpha)+O_K(n^(alpha-1))>0 on compact K⊂(-1,1). The exact derivative identity S_n'=2alpha S_(n-1)^(alpha+1), together with Tran–White’s all-real derivative zeros and arcsine limiting density for alpha+1>1, bounds the number of real S_n zeros by derivative zeros in shrinking endpoint neighborhoods plus at most three (two components and one negative exterior root). x>=1 positivity follows from generating-function coefficient positivity; x<=-1 admits at most one zero since the derivative has no exterior zeros. The endpoint arcsine mass tends to zero, yielding R_n/n→0. Tran–White Theorem 1 covers alpha>=1; α=1 classical Chebyshev. Exact rational Legendre recurrence checked n=3,5,8,10,12 as a diagnostic only.
